title: Charges and payments
description: Due dates, items for automatic charges, reminders, arrears, receipts and registers.

charges.title: Charges
charges.autoRequest: Automatically send the payment request when a charge is created

originItems.title: Items by origin
originItems.description: Charges without a price list (fees, common charges, transfers, terminations, deposits, opening balances) use these items for VAT and codes.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Days from the due date (negative = before) and enabled levels.
reminders.finalHint: The final notice always requires an operator's approval.

arrears.title: Arrears
arrears.description: When enabled, suspends contracts with overdue amounts above the threshold; resuming is manual and departures are never blocked.

fiscal.title: Receipts and fiscal module
fiscal.bridgeDeviceEmpty: No desktop paired in remote mode
fiscal.bridgeDeviceHint: The desktop paired with the online Porto prints the documents on the local fiscal device.
